# Vasyl Mosiiuk
**Senior Software Engineer** | .NET · TypeScript · Python · Windows internals · Cloud backends · AI agents

Lviv, Ukraine · vasyl.mosiiuk@gmail.com · [linkedin.com/in/vasylmosiiuk](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vasylmosiiuk/) · [github.com/vasylmosiiuk](https://github.com/vasylmosiiuk)

## Summary

Senior software engineer with 12+ years in .NET, including 6 years at UiPath building automation and process-discovery products end to end: Windows capture engines and desktop data pipelines, multi-tenant ASP.NET Core services on Azure, on-premises Kubernetes releases and, since 2026, AI agents in TypeScript and Python. Known for re-architecting unstable components, owning security and release work, and unblocking cross-team releases.

## Skills

- **Languages:** C#, TypeScript, Python, SQL, C++ (interop)
- **Backend & cloud:** ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server, SignalR, Redis, Azure (Blob Storage, Key Vault, App Insights), Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Dapr, ArgoCD
- **Desktop & mobile:** .NET 5–8, WPF, Win32 API, Low-level input hooks, COM / Office interop, UI Automation, Xamarin (iOS, Android), Electron, React, WiX installers
- **AI & data:** LLM agents (memory, skills), OCR, PII detection and masking, Computer-vision pipelines, Claude Code
- **Engineering practice:** Azure DevOps CI/CD, xUnit, Vitest, pytest, SonarQube, CVE remediation (Wiz, FOSSA), Production on-call, Technical design documents

## Experience

### Senior Software Engineer — UiPath (Jun 2020 – Present)
_Lviv, Ukraine · Enterprise automation and AI-agent platform._

**AI assistant and desktop agent** (May 2026 – Present)
- Shipped user-scoped agent memory synced across devices, a Skills tab with import and export, and @ file references for UiPath Autopilot in Studio Web, Studio Desktop and Portal.
- Built one skills-archive service shared by the Delegate desktop app and the embedded web app.
- Added command-line start/stop so IT teams can run time-limited unattended capture through Intune.
- _Tech: TypeScript, React, Electron, Python (FastAPI), C# interop_

**Deployment tool for financial-services solutions** (Jan 2026 – May 2026)
- Built a cross-platform Python CLI that installs vertical solutions onto customer tenants from one manifest-driven package: PKCE sign-in, Orchestrator and Data Fabric provisioning, data seeding, backup and restore.
- Created build-once-deploy-many Azure DevOps pipelines and a Data Fabric schema shared across solutions; covered the CLI with 104 tests at 80% coverage.
- Wrote the install guide and package specification, and onboarded new contributors.
- _Tech: Python, Click, pytest, OAuth PKCE, Azure DevOps, UiPath Data Fabric, Orchestrator_

**Cloud backend and on-premises releases for a process-discovery platform** (Jul 2024 – 2026)
- Designed real-time remote control of desktop recorder fleets over SignalR with Redis-backed state, plus recording schedules and privacy allow and deny lists.
- Delivered entitlement-based licensing enforcement and a generic PDD/SOP document-export platform in ASP.NET Core, removing 6.6k lines of legacy code.
- Owned remediation of about 80 Wiz, FedRAMP and FOSSA findings, and drove a cross-team Dapr 1.11 → 1.15 upgrade that unblocked an Automation Suite release candidate.
- As production on-call engineer, triaged 48 incidents and 13 SLO breaches and executed a speech-to-text provider cutover across 8 production regions.
- _Tech: C#, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server, SignalR, Redis, Azure, Kubernetes, Helm, Dapr_

**Desktop activity recorders** (Jul 2022 – Dec 2025)
- Built OS-level capture for Windows recorders: low-level input hooks, clipboard and file tracking, Office and Word interop, SAP GUI scripting, and a DLL-injection plugin shipped in the 23.4 release.
- Moved the recorders to .NET 8 with self-contained installers and direct-to-blob image upload.
- Ported Task Capture to macOS with multi-display capture and OCR on arm64 and x64.
- _Tech: C#, .NET 8, WPF, Win32 API, COM interop, UI Automation, WiX_

**Desktop data-processing pipeline** (Jun 2020 – Apr 2023)
- Re-architected the component behind most customer-reported issues on TPL Dataflow, state machines and Polly; split it into controller and worker processes and moved storage from SQLite to LiteDB.
- Integrated OCR, computer vision and PII masking in sandboxed processes; built continuous cloud upload within a 500 MB memory budget and CPU throttling driven by user activity.
- Led the .NET 5 → 6 migration with self-contained builds and security builds for long-term-support release lines.
- _Tech: C#, .NET 6, TPL Dataflow, Polly, LiteDB, Named pipes_
